method: One process and stream per card; CUDA events; five interleaved rounds, up to 40 samples per configuration per round. Locked clocks requested. Baseline q64 k64, no entry hints.
reference: Torch f64 attention on bf16-rounded inputs for bf16, f64 inputs for f64. Approximate division is separately checked against exact division at the same configuration. SDPA uses bf16 or f64 according to the row; cuTile controls are bf16 with f32 accumulation.

alignment_method.comparison: Dawn cubins only; external comparator timings are not used in these alignment ratios.
